facility.name: Irma O Huerta
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The antiseptic wipes in the first aid kit were expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §747.3803(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parent handbook did not contain the Parent Rights. This was corrected at inspection when form 2987 Parent Rights was added to the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The operation was not maintaining records of the emergency drills. This was corrected at inspection when form 7263 Emergency Practices was provided to the operation and the drills were entered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not have proof of training in administering medication and preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or allergic reactions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Mats were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: An infant was observed sitting in a car seat carrier with thie carrier covered by a blanket. The blanket was propped up by the handle. This was corrected at inspection when the blanket was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §747.2329)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The playground was seen during an inspection with hazards present such as a post digger, household paint, and packaged hygiene items stacked against a wall of the house that could topple over. The yard also has many large branches present and the grass requires yard maintenance due to the height. The fence gate is damaged, one of the pickets is broken creating a hole in the gate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A 4 month old infant was present during screen time use.  Note: This was corrected when the TV was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Five children were found to be supervised by a non-qualified caregiver.  Note: This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §747.203)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: Five children were seen supervised by a person without a background check initiated with the operation.  Note:This was corrected when the Primary Care provider returned to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate: The provider does not have an age appropriate nap mat for the 2 year old child in care available for viewing during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The playground has 3 pieces of equipment that require use zones that have inadequate space around the equipment for the use zone. 2 slides and one climbing dome.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines: A trampoline more than 4 feet in diameter is present on the playground during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines (26 TAC §747.4403(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A 7 year old child is seen during an inspection watching cartoons that is not related to planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The provider does not have current training in Infant safe sleep, early childhood brain development, or preventing shaken baby syndrome available for review during an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 3 month old infant was seen sleeping in a crib with a blanket wrapped around them, clean diapers present, and a napkins present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The playground was seen during an inspection with hazards present such as a weed eater, post digger, dirty cat litter box, and household paint all in areas accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: The director and a caregiver did not have an Affidavit on file available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §747.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: There was one child file that did not have a health statement, signed by the child's health care physician, available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: There were two children files that did not have an updated immunization record available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There were paint cans, tools, wood planks, metal pieces, and sheet rock that were in the outdoor play area accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
